item.title: Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma's adorable moment takes social media by storm
item.description: Virat Kohli shared a quiet moment with his wife Anushka Sharma on Instagram. The cricketer posted a minimalist photograph featuring their matching white sneakers. This personal glimpse comes after a highly successful IPL season for Kohli. He also performed well in recent international ODI matches against England. Kohli is now preparing for upcoming ODI series against the West Indies.

item.title: Recent rain has little impact on national monsoon deficit
item.description: Recent rains have brought relief to Delhi, Haryana, and eastern Rajasthan, yet the national monsoon deficit persists. States like Bihar and Punjab continue to struggle with below-average rainfall. While the sowing of Kharif crops is nearly finalized across the nation, August's rainfall may enhance water reservoirs for hydropower and upcoming planting seasons, with a low-pressure area potentially raising precipitation levels in eastern India shortly.
item.dc:creator: VISHWA MOHAN

item.title: Sundar Pichai's letter to Google staff on AI leadership change: 'We'll keep moving'
item.description: Google announced significant leadership changes within its DeepMind division. Demis Hassabis will now chair Google DeepMind and serve as Chief Scientist. Koray Kavukcuoglu steps up as Senior Vice President overseeing Gemini model development. Long-time employee Jeff Dean departs to launch a new public benefit corporation. These shifts aim to accelerate Google's artificial intelligence strategy and research.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Indian, US navies kick off 5-day specialised diving, EOD exercise in Kochi
item.description: In a significant show of unity, the Indian and US navies will engage in a five-day explosive ordnance disposal drill in Kochi. This advanced training initiative aims to bolster interoperability and foster teamwork between the participating units. The event will encompass expert discussions, shared training techniques, and practical exercises. This marks the eighth edition of their cooperative training, emphasizing a mutual focus on enhancing maritime security operations.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Filmmaker Shakeel Noorani held for rape, blackmail of aspiring actress
item.description: After evading capture for forty days, producer-director Shakeel Noorani has been arrested. He is charged with multiple counts of rape and intimidation against an aspiring actress, with incidents reportedly occurring over a four-year period at his home. The police deployed technical resources to track him down to a farmhouse in Mahabaleshwar. Following his arrest, he was presented in court and remanded in custody.
item.dc:creator: V NARAYAN

item.title: Op Sindoor showed India will go to any extent to protect its citizens: Defence min
item.description: Defence minister Rajnath Singh lauded Operation Sindoor for protecting citizens and sending a strong global message. He compared the operation's courage to the compassion shown at a large blood donation camp. Around one thousand wrestlers and athletes from Maharashtra donated blood at the Delhi Cantt event. Singh emphasized blood donation as a vital contribution, calling it 'Jivandan' and 'Mahadan'.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Michael Dell son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
item.description: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America. These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers. The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology. Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide. This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Police search 26 locations tied to banned Jamaat-e-Islami J&K
item.description: Authorities conducted extensive searches at twenty-six locations in Sopore, north Kashmir, specifically targeting the premises of Jamaat-e-Islami J&K. Critical documents and electronic devices were seized amid an investigation into the organization’s potential ties to terrorism. This operation is part of an intensified effort in the area following the tragic shooting of a police officer, highlighting ongoing security threats posed by the banned group.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Florida scientists turn 39 surviving clams into 65 million
item.description: Florida's Indian River Lagoon shows signs of recovery after decades of environmental decline. Scientists are restoring critical habitats like reefs, shellfish beds, seagrass, and wetlands. Efforts focus on reintroducing clams, which were nearly extinct due to overharvesting and algal blooms. Millions of juvenile and adult "super clams" have been released into the lagoon. Local governments are addressing runoff issues to support the lagoon's ongoing restoration.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Virginia teen uses AI and CRISPR to boost biofuel from microalgae
item.description: Fourteen-year-old Millie Pradawong has developed an AI-powered computational tool that predicts how CRISPR gene editing could improve microalgae for biofuel production. Her project, MACRO, aims to increase oil production without reducing algae growth. A finalist in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge, Millie hopes her work will support future research in clean energy and biotechnology.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani extends tax deadline after residents call emails 'unclear'
item.description: New York City has announced an extension for the pied-à-terre tax exemption deadline to September eighteenth, responding to resident concerns about the lack of clear notifications and the complexities of the exemption process. To enhance communication citywide, particularly across boroughs, outreach initiatives are being intensified. The pied-à-terre tax impacts secondary residences valued at over five million dollars, a strategy designed to bolster the city's budget amid a financial shortfall.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: PMAY-Urban: Govt says 1.25 crore houses sanctioned, 1 crore delivered
item.description: The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban has granted over 1.25 crore homes, with more than one crore completed to date. Notably, one crore of those houses were designated for women beneficiaries nationwide. Recently, the scheme approved an additional 2.09 lakh homes for economically weaker section families, bringing the total under PMAY-U 2.0 to over 18.38 lakh houses. The government is diligently assessing the scheme's execution and fund use across various states.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Search ops involving Indian Navy for 3 missing fishermen continue in Kerala
item.description: The Indian Navy's search for three missing fishermen continues into its tenth day. Divers are utilizing portable SONAR to enhance underwater surveillance capabilities. INS Kalpeni joined the operation, sailing from Kochi to aid the search efforts. The search initially focused on Gautam Krishna, who went missing off the Neendakara coast. The operation is ongoing off the Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram coasts.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Patrick Mahomes’ million-dollar collection: Cars, watches, mansions and more
item.description: Beyond the gridiron, Patrick Mahomes is crafting a formidable business empire. His strategic investments in sports franchises and innovative tech firms underscore his savvy approach to entrepreneurship. Coupled with lucrative endorsements from major global brands, Mahomes enjoys a life adorned with exotic cars, high-end watches, and luxurious homes. This multifaceted portfolio highlights his ambition and keen sense for success in business.
item.dc:creator: DR. ARATI KULKARNI SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Jannik Sinner’s inspiring journey from mountain roots to tennis glory
item.description: Jannik Sinner’s rise to world No. 1 is about much more than tennis. Growing up in a hardworking family, leaving home at 14 and always having his parents’ support helped shape the person he is today. Their trust and freedom gave him the confidence to follow his own path, making his success an inspiring story far beyond sport.

item.title: What is AI model distillation and why is it becoming a US-China flashpoint?
item.description: The competition between the US and China in the realm of artificial intelligence has shifted focus towards harnessing model capabilities rather than merely their creation. AI model distillation enables smaller systems to mimic larger counterparts, which has sparked concerns over security. There are reports that Chinese military researchers are utilizing outputs from US AI models for defense purposes.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Horoscope today: Daily astrological predictions for August 10, 2026
item.description: Horoscope Today: Read daily horoscope predictions for August 10, 2026. Know all about the astrological events and influences that will be affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. Our astrologer has analyzed the movements of the planets and the alignment of the stars to bring you the most accurate and up-to-date horoscope predictions for the day ahead. Get ready to discover what the stars have in store for you today.

item.title: 6,6,6! Siraj goes boom with 3 sixes in final over as India seal six-wicket win - Watch
item.description: Mohammed Siraj stunned Sri Lanka Cricket XI with an explosive 32 off 15 balls, smashing three consecutive sixes in the final over to seal India’s six-wicket win with three balls remaining. His unbeaten cameo included four sixes and a boundary. Yashasvi Jaiswal, Shubman Gill and Rishabh Pant also contributed, giving India valuable preparation ahead of the first Test in Galle.

item.title: What happens after you apply for an organ transplant?
item.description: From medical evaluation and registry enrolment to waitlist priority, organ matching, surgery and lifelong follow-up, the transplant process in India involves multiple clinical, regulatory and coordination stages before a patient receives an organ.
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: 'We know how to stand up to American ideas': Netanyahu rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza plan
item.description: Israel has turned down a US proposal regarding the peace process in Gaza, with Prime Minister Netanyahu firmly asserting that Hamas must be completely disarmed before any Israeli forces withdraw. He mentioned that discussions are ongoing with Washington. Conversely, Hamas demands a complete Israeli troop withdrawal as a prerequisite for negotiation, reflecting significant barriers to advancing beyond the current ceasefire.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: US Navy needs 66 attack submarines but fleet could fall to 46-47 by 2030
item.description: The USS San Juan submarine retired after thirty-eight years of service. Aging submarines are leaving service faster than new ones are delivered. This creates a significant gap in the United States attack submarine fleet. Production challenges and other naval programs compound the submarine shortage. The US Navy faces growing demands from global adversaries and allies.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Will Kuldeep Yadav play? India coach reveals big selection headache ahead of Galle Test
item.description: India's spin bowling coach addressed worries about Kuldeep Yadav's fitness after the warm-up match, highlighting that Kuldeep bowled almost twenty overs before taking a precautionary break to evaluate his condition. Fellow spinners Jadeja and Suthar garnered extensive pitch experience with longer spells. Meanwhile, Shubman Gill, returning from a hand injury, participated fully in drills. The team's focus remained on adapting to local conditions in readiness for the upcoming Test series.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: What Saudi-Pak-Turkey Mecca defence deal means for India's future military ops
item.description: The agreement comes as Saudi Arabia faces a difficult regional security environment shaped by the conflict involving Iran, Israel and the United States, threats from Iran-aligned groups and continuing concerns over the safety of energy infrastructure and maritime routes. Saudi Arabia has traditionally relied heavily on the United States for security but recent regional crises have increased emphasis in Gulf capitals on developing additional security partnerships and greater regional burden-sharing.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Watch: PM Modi meets CWG medallists, says ‘Jo khelega, woh khilega’
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met India’s Commonwealth Games 2026 medallists in New Delhi and congratulated them after the country finished fourth in Glasgow. Sharing a video, he wrote, "Always #Cheer4Bharat." Modi told athletes, "Jo khelega, woh khilega" and led them in chanting "Bharat Mata ki Jai." India won 39 medals, with Ahmedabad set to host the 2030 Games.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: '$200 bn market in 15 countries': Here's what India can do if US slaps 100% tariffs
item.description: As the US contemplates imposing substantial tariffs on Russian crude, India is strategically exploring alternative markets to bolster its exports. With fifteen potential markets worth an impressive two hundred billion dollars, Indian exporters are adapting to global challenges. In contrast to the US, where merchandise exports reached eighty-seven billion dollars, shipments to alternative destinations are growing more rapidly, indicating resilient export dynamics.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Sarfaraz Khan replaces Sai Sudharsan in India squad for Sri Lanka Tests
item.description: India's Test squad sees a new addition as Sarfaraz Khan steps in for the injured Sai Sudharsan ahead of the Sri Lanka series. Sudharsan is sidelined due to a toe injury. The selectors felt Sarfaraz's middle-order experience would be invaluable. After a warm-up triumph, the team gears up for the first Test match starting on August 15.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: Clean power push: India hits 300 GW non-fossil capacity milestone ahead of 2030 target
item.description: India has now achieved over 300 GW of non-fossil fuel electricity generation capacity. This significant milestone represents more than half of the nation's total installed power capacity. Solar power leads this expansion, followed by wind and hydro energy sources. The country aims to reach 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by the year 2030. Domestic manufacturing for solar equipment has also seen substantial growth.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 'Stones thrown to kill Mamata on CM's order': TMC MPs allege 'attempt to murder'
item.description: Trinamool Congress leaders accused the BJP of orchestrating an attack on Mamata Banerjee's vehicle. Stones and objects were reportedly hurled at her car while she traveled to meet a grieving family. TMC MPs described the incident as an attempt to murder and a failure of governance. Mamata Banerjee herself stated the attack could have caused serious injuries or death.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Skyroot founder reacts to PM Modi's 'first in my bloodline' remark
item.description: In a heartfelt address, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the aspirations of young engineers embarking on their rocket-building journeys as the first in their families to do so. Pawan Kumar Chandana, co-founder of Skyroot Aerospace, resonates deeply with these aspiring talents. After his tenure at ISRO, he co-founded Skyroot in Hyderabad, achieving a historic moment by launching India's first privately developed suborbital rocket, Vikram-S.
item.dc:creator: TRENDING DESK

item.title: 'I’m tearing it up': Rahane's shocking revelation that saved Jaiswal from ban
item.description: Ajinkya Rahane discussed his intervention during a 2022 Duleep Trophy final match. He prevented Yashasvi Jaiswal from receiving a four-match ban from the match referee. Rahane sensed the situation was escalating and took responsibility as captain. Jaiswal later produced a match-winning performance and debuted for India. This intervention protected Jaiswal's promising cricket career.

item.title: Nine injured after furnace explosion at private steel plant in Jharkhand
item.description: An explosion in a furnace chamber at a private steel plant injured nine workers on Sunday. Two critically injured workers were transferred to a Ranchi hospital for advanced treatment. Hot metal splashed after the furnace chamber explosion, causing burn injuries to the workers. An inquiry has been ordered to determine the exact circumstances leading to the incident. The chief factory inspector directed an immediate investigation into the matter.

item.title: 'Hellscape' strategy: How Taiwan plans to use drones to stop China in its tracks
item.description: Taiwan is rapidly building drone fleets to deter a Chinese invasion. This strategy draws lessons from Ukraine's successful drone warfare against Russia. The island aims to produce 100,000 drones monthly by 2030 for defense. Taiwanese companies are also expanding drone exports and manufacturing capabilities. This effort includes developing maritime drones and essential drone components.
